This new entry rests on one written token. The supplied MT supports presentation only; the Turoyo supplies the target -lən and the hostile purpose lašan d oṯe ḏarbo ʕal as səryoye. Shouting remains a tentative lexical identification.

Retain the reader’s stem label I provisionally, following the glossary’s treatment of the comparable reduplicated m-form bṣbṣ as I (mbaṣbaṣle/mbaṣbəṣ). Four root letters alone do not justify changing the label to Q.
